expectations.text: Gives an explicit decision framework (automate-now / automate-later / keep-manual) rather than a blanket 'automate everything' recommendation
expectations.evidence: Section 2 table assigns every one of the reconstructed 60 cases to Automate-now (52), Automate-later (3), or Manual/exploratory (5) with a stated reason per group, and explicitly names the 5 manual-forever cases (screen-reader UX, wording polish, concurrent-upload race probing).

expectations.text: Proposes a test pyramid split (unit/integration/E2E) with reasoning tied to this specific domain, not just a generic unexplained ratio
expectations.evidence: Section 1: 65/25/10 split explicitly justified as skewed further unit-heavy than a generic 70/20/10 default because 'both of this feature's High-risk areas...are naturally pure-function business logic with almost no I/O dependency.'

expectations.text: Addresses CSV import specifically, including malformed-file or bad-data edge cases
expectations.evidence: Group A lists 16 cases including 'missing columns, wrong delimiter, encoding issues (UTF-8/BOM), extra whitespace, empty file, header-only file.'

expectations.text: Addresses holdings-calculation logic specifically, including numerical edge cases (rounding, zero/negative values, currency conversion if relevant)
expectations.evidence: Groups E/F list 'FIFO/average-cost lot tracking, partial sells, multiple buys at different prices, fractional shares, short positions... stock split adjustment, dividend reinvestment, merger/spin-off adjustment.'

expectations.text: Recommends unit tests as the primary home for calculation logic given it's fast, isolated business logic
expectations.evidence: Section 2, Group E: 'This is the highest-value automation in the whole suite... a unit test with a known-correct expected value is [the reliable oracle].'

expectations.text: Addresses CI integration -- when different test levels should run (PR vs nightly vs pre-release)
expectations.evidence: Section 4 table maps unit->every PR (blocks merge), integration->merge to main (blocks staging deploy), E2E->nightly (reports only) and pre-release (blocks release).

expectations.text: Addresses a flaky-test policy or how to handle intermittent failures
expectations.evidence: Section 5 defines identification threshold (2 failures in 10 rolling CI runs), quarantine tagging, ownership assignment, a 2-week fix-by date, and weekly Test Lead review of quarantine-list size.

eval_feedback.overall: Strong, discriminating run. This run correctly flagged that it was never given the actual 60 test cases or a real Phase 0 risk register, so it reconstructed a plausible taxonomy and explicitly labeled the automate/manual decision table as a draft pending reconciliation with real case IDs -- good calibrated honesty, not overclaiming.
